topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
response: Satellite orbital configurations can optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes. The Context highlights high fixed latencies on satellite links, which negatively impact Quality of Service (QoS). By adjusting orbital configurations, such as altitude and inclination, satellites can reduce signal travel time. This optimization is critical for latency-sensitive applications, like real-time services, which require guaranteed latency below 250ms.
